opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or recognised research organisation; UK or EEA nationals (or doctorate from UK); early-career with Viva completed between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027; not permanently appointed.
opportunities.summary: Three-year award for early‑career researchers to pursue an independent research project in the humanities or social sciences.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK residents holding a long‑term appointment at a UK higher‑education institution or independent research organisation, undertaking research in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £10,000 to support skill development, methodological innovation and collaborative activities for UK‑based researchers.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be a UK‑based independent researcher with a permanent or fixed‑term position and teaching duties, based at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation; co‑applicant must have complementary expertise from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding up to £200k for established researchers to pursue interdisciplinary projects across humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, and engineering.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher, any career stage, partnering with a gallery, archive, library, museum or performing‑arts organisation.
opportunities.summary: Public‑engagement awards up to £8,000 for innovative projects that involve collaboration with cultural or performing‑arts organisations.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships up to £150k for researchers to work at DGAP in Berlin on policy‑relevant projects.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences with a lasting role at a UK university or institute; must involve international co‑applicants and interdisciplinary collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £300k over two years for interdisciplinary projects on mobilities involving UK researchers and international partners.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany.
opportunities.summary: Funding to attend a three‑day symposium and develop collaborative projects; covers travel, accommodation and visa costs.
